data.summary: Transformation-focused Process Improvement Leader with decade of experience orchestrating large-scale digital transformation programs in global retail and commercial banking. Proven track record managing end-to-end delivery of customer onboarding, digital platform migration, and online banking initiatives across EMEA and US markets. Expert at translating complex regulatory requirements into scalable implementation roadmaps, embedding control frameworks, and driving cross-functional alignment between Compliance, Operations, Technology, and Business stakeholders. Advanced proficiency in Agile delivery methodologies, Jira/Confluence project management, and governance frameworks. Demonstrated track record managing complex, regulated environments while maintaining audit readiness and internal control standards.

experience.role: Project Manager – Client Processing / Onboarding (Transformation & Automation Lead)
responsibilities: Led strategic operations across multi-tier teams of Analysts, Associates, and Team Leaders, ensuring consistent delivery excellence through robust governance, structured review mechanisms, and proactive performance management.

Led end-to-end delivery of customer onboarding platform redesign with embedded KYC and CDD controls, reducing turnaround time by 40% and improving regulatory compliance alignment and adoption across retail business lines.

Championed people development through tailored coaching frameworks, capability-building programs, and continuous feedback cycles cultivating a culture of accountability, innovation, and operational ownership.

Translated complex compliance, operational, and regulatory risks into clear, data-driven narratives and governance materials (status reports, dashboards, steering committee packs, risk escalations) that enabled informed decision-making by senior stakeholders and regulatory bodies on technology investments and process redesign.

Acted as principal liaison between regional business units, front-office, finance, and operations, building trust-based advisory relationships and driving alignment on transformation priorities and roadmap.

Led end-to-end transformation of customer onboarding from manual-heavy processes to digital-first platform, delivering across discovery, design, technology implementation, and organizational change management.
Embedded a strong compliance culture by reinforcing internal control frameworks, elevating risk awareness, and ensuring auditreadiness in all operational activities.

Led multi-phase process improvement initiatives across client onboarding and transaction lifecycle, using Alteryx/Tableau-based analytics to identify bottlenecks, quantify efficiency gaps, and prioritize re-engineering opportunities.

Conducted time-and-motion and workload studies across cross-regional teams, designing regulatory delivery roadmaps resulting in 40% productivity uplift and 60% reduction in manual touchpoints through control-aware process redesign and automation, while maintaining compliance standards.
Drove cross-regional transformation projects that enhanced operational integrity, improved onboarding turnaround, and elevated client experience across business lines.
Supervised the implementation and adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows, leading stakeholder enablement, training, and post-implementation optimization.
Partnered with global reporting and operations teams to design and implement process innovations that enhanced efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across client processing functions.
Led automation initiatives by developing and optimizing intelligent solutions that streamlined data management, reporting, and workflow execution, improving turnaround times.
Provided technical and analytical support for existing EMEA automation solutions while identifying opportunities for global deployment and process harmonization.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure technology enhancements aligned with regional objectives, compliance standards, and business growth strategies.
Assessed, piloted, and implemented new digital tools to strengthen the EMEA innovation framework, driving a culture of continuous improvement and digital enablement.

Advised leading financial institutions on designing and implementing Compliance & Regulatory (C&R) programs, specializing in Retail KYC, Customer Onboarding, and CDD (Customer Due Diligence) process optimization to align with evolving global AML, KYC, and FATCA standards and regulatory requirements.

Conducted diagnostic reviews to identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and technology limitations within client onboarding and monitoring workflows, providing actionable recommendations for remediation.
Collaborated with cross-functional and technology teams to translate business requirements into enhanced compliance solutions, driving improved transparency, data integrity, and risk oversight.
Supported the design and deployment of digital accelerators to streamline financial crime prevention workflows, contributing to measurable efficiency and assurance improvements.
Actively contributed to global innovation programs, developing process improvement models and regulatory tools that were recognized for excellence and impact across PwC’s global network.
Twice recognized as a finalist and winner in PwC’s Global Innovation Challenge for pioneering initiatives that advanced operational transparency and compliance effectiveness.
Performed comprehensive data audits and performance-trend analyses to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence of geographic datasets to global publishing and quality standards.
Partnered with cross-functional teams in product and engineering to streamline data validation processes, enhance input accuracy, and minimize production feedback loops.
Supported continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process inefficiencies and implementing corrective actions that enhanced overall data reliability and timeliness.
Conducted a time and motion study to evaluate workflow efficiency, leading to measurable reductions in process waste and improvements in operational quality and output consistency.

projects.name: Investor Portal Migration
projects.description: Led the end-to-end migration of the Investor Portal from a third-party vendor to an in-house platform, mapping and redesigning workflows with technology and operations

projects.name: Data Loader Implementation
projects.description: Designed and implemented an automated data loader for the Investran platform to replace manual custodian data entry, improving data timeliness and accuracy, strengthening auditability, and reducing operational effort and break rates across downstream reporting.

projects.name: Bulk Wire RPA Project (Transfer Agency)
projects.description: Led end-to-end robotic process automation initiative from diagnostic assessment to solution design and rollout. Mapped current-state process, identified automation candidates, partnered with technology to design RPA workflows, and managed change adoption—achieving ~82% reduction in processing time and freeing capacity for higher-value work.

projects.name: Transfer Agency Policy Platform
projects.description: Drove the implementation of a centralized digital platform for Transfer Agency policies and SOPs, consolidating fragmented documentation into a single source of truth that improved accessibility, version control, compliance oversight, and consistent policy adoption across global teams.

projects.name: Global Digital Tools Champion Program
projects.description: Designed and scaled a community-driven automation and analytics adoption program from Poland to global operations, coaching “champions” to drive local use-cases in Alteryx, Python, and other tools. Increased digital tool adoption and helped create a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.
